name: inventory_refactor_totals
task: inventory_total_value() and inventory_total_quantity() duplicate the same loop-over-items structure, differing only in the per-item quantity extracted/accumulated. Refactor them to eliminate the duplication by extracting a shared static helper function that both call (e.g. a generic accumulator taking a function pointer, or an internal loop helper parameterized by what to sum). Keep both public function signatures and their behavior unchanged.
